scripts.build: rm -rf ../../plugins/runtime/hooks ../../plugins/runtime/bin ../../plugins/runtime/content && claude-code-hooks -i "src/**/*.ts" -o "../../plugins/runtime/hooks/hooks.json" --loader .md=text --loader .txt=text --log-env-var CLAUDE_CODE_RUNTIME_HOOKS_LOG_FILE --executable "\$(cat \$HOME/.cards/VSCODE_NODE 2>/dev/null || echo node)" && yarn build:watcher && yarn build:mcp-server
scripts.build:watcher: esbuild src/bin/transcript-watcher.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --tree-shaking=true --outfile=../../plugins/runtime/bin/transcript-watcher.mjs '--external:node:*' '--banner:js=import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);'
